ad_library.summary: Suryon is running active ads on Meta (Facebook/Instagram) — about 27 live results in the Ad Library. On Google's network, the transparency centre shows roughly 6 live ads. Meanwhile ~320 live Meta ads from competitors in Hyderabad and 3 Indian advertisers on Google Ads in the solar category are capturing the same customers.
